text:
ana: Quick flag - saw ~1.5% of MQLs yesterday land in HubSpot with no owner. Router logs show enrich stayed in 'pending' and then the router returned no-route at the circuit-breaker boundary. Can we patch a short-term canary?

tyler: Saw it too. enrichment-service had a p95 spike ~50s. Current router CB is aggressive: after 25s it returns no-route. That leaves records ownerless and blocks outbound SDR touches.

hs-bot: HubSpot event: 2026-03-22T14:12:13Z - lead created (owner_id: null).

organize-bot: Note: we already have a TODO from Q4 for an overflow pool but no active flag.

matt: Proposal: add a circuit-breaker canary that does two things: 1) short assign to a soft-overflow pool after 18s with tag 'cb_canary', 2) set hs_pending_enrich_ts and hs_handoff_mode so reports can split these from normal flows. Reconcile if enrichment completes within 2m.

sophia: +1. Also add hs_no_sequence boolean when handoff_mode starts with 'cb_' to prevent immediate nurture.

lee: Implementation sketch:

```
if (enrich_pending && now - enrich_start > 18s && flag('marketing.cb_canary')) {
  assignOverflow('soft_overflow')
  setMeta('handoff_mode','cb_canary')
  setMeta('pending_since', enrich_start)
  scheduleReconcile(120s)
}
```
Make sure SF/HS integrations honor hs_no_sequence for suppression.

tyler: I'll open a small PR gated behind marketing.cb_canary and include tests for race where enrichment callback wins before overflow assign. Also emit metrics: cb_fallback_rate and cb_reconcile_success.

anа: (typo corrected) ana: Action items: tyler (PR + flag), matt (create soft_overflow pool), sophia (HS mapping + suppression field), lee (reconcile job), organize-bot to post canary schedule.

organize-bot: Canary window proposed: 03/23 02:00-06:00 UTC. Will auto-disable if cb_fallback_rate > 1% or reconcile_success < 70%.

matt: For audit SQL stub:

```
SELECT count(*) AS affected, hs_handoff_mode
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
AND owner_id IS NULL
GROUP BY hs_handoff_mode;
```
I'll run this after the canary.

sophia: HubSpot mapping proposed:
metadata.pending_since -> hs_pending_enrich_ts
metadata.handoff_mode -> hs_handoff_mode
metadata.reconcile_id -> hs_reconcile_id
hs_no_sequence -> hs_no_sequence

tyler: One more safety: skip assigning overflow to SDRs with 'no_overflow' tag and rotate using overflow_token. Prevent hot-spotting.

ana: Small note: please add a visible label in the SDR queue 'CB Canary' so ops can spot these fast.

organize-bot: Incident created: #marketing-cb-canary-3099999999.

lee: Will ensure reconcile path uses idempotent owner updates and adds X-Handoff-Origin header for SF sync.

tyler: PR link (draft): github.com/redwood/lead-router/pull/9999 - tests + feature flag. Will request reviews.

ana: Great. If we can land the flag and HS mapping by tomorrow morning we can run the scheduled canary. Keep alerts loud and rollback if noisy. :thumbsup:
